Hi everyone! I've been struggling to get the supabase MCP working for cursor. I'm thinking the issue is I'm on a windows machine? I was able to get the Postgres MCP Server installed and even added the executable to my PATH. Has anyone been able to successfully run the this command on windows? npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres <connection-string>?

I did some troubleshooting with o1 and Grok and no luck.
I've tried
1.) appending the call with cmd /c
2.) double quotes around the command
3.) Escaping special characters in the command

I tested the creds with a test script and PGadmin and I can hit my databases no problem.
